description:
xLights is a free and open source program that enables you to design, create and play amazing lighting displays through the use of DMX controllers, E1.31 Ethernet controllers and more.


2026.21 — November 24, 2026
Enhancements
- dkulp — Layout, controller and effect preset changes saved by someone else to a shared show folder are merged with yours when you save: you choose only where you both changed the same thing, or where they deleted a model the open sequence has effects on (keep it, delete it with its effects, or map the effects to another model), and a report lists renames and broken references
- dkulp — Shared show folders: changes someone else saves to the layout, controllers or effect presets are brought into the open show once playback stops, merged with your unsaved edits; where you both changed the same thing, a status bar notice offers Review
- dkulp — Shared show folders: warn when opening a sequence someone else has open, and show who else is editing the layout or controllers in the status bar
- dkulp — Warn instead of silently overwriting layout, controller, preset or sequence changes saved by someone else to a shared show folder
- dkulp — Autosaves in a shared show folder are kept per computer and only offered back on the computer that wrote them; restoring one no longer discards changes someone else saved since (merge them, save as a copy, or restore anyway)
- dkulp — Opening a sequence saved before models were renamed in the layout (here or by someone sharing the show folder) renames its rows to match instead of asking about missing models
- dkulp — Offer to merge the conflicted copies Dropbox, iCloud, OneDrive, Google Drive or Syncthing leave of the layout, controller or preset files; the copy is then moved to the Backup folder
- dkulp — Show files are saved in one step, so a crash or a sync client never sees a half-written file; tags, permissions, creation date and hard links are kept
- dkulp — Undo now covers adding, deleting, renaming and reordering timing tracks, adding, removing and reordering models in the sequence, timing imports, tags, song structure and sequence face edits
- dkulp — Import Effects (every format, and the automation import commands) can be undone in one step, including the timing tracks, models, images and faces it added
- dkulp — Shift Effects, Shift Effects And Timing, Shift Selected Effects, Convert Data To Effects, Promote Node Effects and the clearModelEffects / cloneModelEffects automation commands can be undone in one step
- dkulp — Creating, linking, unlinking, renaming and deleting effect symbols and Convert Symbols to Effects can be undone
- dkulp — Sequence media edits can be undone: add, embed, extract, rename, remove, re-embed, re-select, bulk find/copy, embed/extract all, and removing unused media and AI images
- Upercat — Custom Model: drag with the middle mouse button to pan the grid (#7416)
- derwin12 — Layout: Esc exits the active model drawing tool (e.g. Single Line)
- scott — Lyrics: Generate AI Image for Phrase adds a Pictures effect with an AI-generated image for the phrase's time range
- scott — Controller Visualiser: drag a port's label onto another port to move all its models there, or onto the model pool to remove them
- derwin12 — FPP Connect: the upload log and Completed list show whether each controller's media was uploaded (with its size), already up to date, or not found
- heffneil — FPP Connect upload window: draggable divider between the controller gauges and the Completed list, which now gets any extra window height
- PeteMatthews — ILightThat controllers: upload grouping, zig zag and start/end null pixels, and refuse settings the board's firmware does not support
- dkulp — iPad - Layout, controller and effect preset changes saved by someone else to a shared show folder are merged with yours when you save: you choose only where you both changed the same item, or where they deleted a model the open sequence has effects on (keep it, delete it with its effects, or map the effects)
- dkulp — iPad - Shared show folders: changes someone else saves to the layout, controllers or effect presets are brought into the open show once playback or a drag ends, merged with your unsaved edits; where you both changed the same thing, a banner offers Review. Can be turned off in Settings
- dkulp — iPad - Shared show folders: warn when opening a sequence someone else has open (open anyway or read-only), and show who else is editing the layout or controllers in the layout editor
- dkulp — iPad - Warn instead of silently overwriting layout, controller, preset or sequence changes saved by someone else to a shared show folder
- dkulp — iPad - Autosaves in a shared show folder are kept per device and only offered back on the iPad that wrote them; restoring one no longer discards changes someone else saved since (save as a copy or restore anyway)
- dkulp — iPad - Timing imports, new timing tracks (every type, including AI lyrics, tempo, chords and onsets), renaming, deleting and making a timing track variable, moving rows, tags, sequence faces and song structure edits can be undone and redone
- dkulp — iPad - Import Effects, SuperStar import and Import Lyrics can be undone in one step, including the timing tracks, models, images and faces they added
- dkulp — iPad - Renaming and deleting effect symbols and Convert All Symbols to Effects can be undone
- dkulp — iPad - Media manager edits can be undone: add, embed, extract, rename, remove, re-embed, replace, embed/extract all, and removing unused media and AI images
- dkulp — iPad - Song structure boundaries can be dragged in the waveform strip; each drag is one undo step
Bug Fixes
- dkulp — Undo could change or delete the wrong effect after some edits, lose effects deleted from a layer that was later removed, and do nothing after a timing track was renamed
- dkulp — Undo of effect settings panel changes restores the effect exactly, including its type and settings added or removed; changes to a second effect of the same type could not be undone; edits after a pause of over a second are their own undo step
- dkulp — Undo of removing a layer brings back the layer's name and effects
- dkulp — Split Effect and Paste as Layers are undone in one step (the first Undo after a split did nothing); a Morph assist double-click can be undone
- dkulp — Undo of Auto Label and Convert Effects To restores the previous label or effect type; undo of deleting an effect linked to a symbol keeps it linked; the automation deleteEffect command can be undone
- dkulp — Undo of Import Lyrics and Breakdown Phrases/Words restores the timing track's previous layers instead of leaving them empty; Remove Words/Phonemes can be undone
- dkulp — Servo linked start/end values: undo takes back the change to the neighbouring effect along with the edited one
- dkulp — Shift Effects no longer moves locked effects (Shift Selected Effects could leave one before the start of the sequence)
- dkulp — Promote Node Effects no longer adds an empty layer when nothing can be promoted
- MrPierreB — Bulk editing a DMX channel slider could clear value curves on unrelated channels of other selected effects
- dkulp — Bulk editing a setting could crash when a submodel or strand row held effects of an unknown type
- dkulp — Adding or removing layers on a submodel or strand row while it rendered could crash
- dkulp — SingleStrand FX with exactly 6 colours on the Default or "* Color Gradient" palette could crash, and its gradient left out colour 5
- derwin12 — Layered Arches with an Inside starting location rendered Strand effects on the wrong nodes when the layers had different sizes
- MrPierreB — Moving Head Adv: position zones were not applied when the effect was on a group containing the model
- derwin12 — Moving Head Adv: the position zone indicator ring stands upright around the yoke again instead of lying flat around the base
- derwin12 — Select Effects listed models with no effects matching all of the Effect Type, Render Style, time and colour filters
- derwin12 — Effect Presets: presets saved with a timing track selected showed a black preview instead of the animated GIF
- NotAFlightRisk — AI Lyrics from Audio could add a very short word as a zero-length mark on 50 ms sequences
- dkulp — AC mode: turning lights off over a range that fully covered a locked effect could hang xLights
- dkulp — Saving pixel edits to an embedded image from the Pictures assist window was silently discarded
- dkulp — Extract All left SVG, shader and text media under their old name while effects were pointed at the extracted file
- dkulp — Renaming embedded media to a path effects already use (but that isn't embedded) no longer fails with "already in use"
- alex — SubModels: Import Custom Model Overlay ignored the chosen alignment column and placed the overlay upside down; all 9 positions now work
- alex — SubModels: Import Custom Model Overlay filled in the empty cells of the outline, importing it as a solid block instead of its shape
- dkulp — Generate Custom Model could crash when the video returned too few frames
- derwin12 — Print Layout printed a different, shifted part of the layout than the dialog's preview showed
- dkulp — Bulk Edit Properties could crash when closed while a property was still being edited
- dkulp — LOR S5 import: Marquee took its speed from the wrong field
- dkulp — LMS import: channels with the same name on different networks got identical names
- dkulp — HLS import: strand names lost their last character, so Map CCR/Strand found no nodes
- derwin12 — Layout Controllers page: the selected controller's red/green status light refreshes on its own (and when clicked) without setting a ping interval
- derwin12 — FPP Connect no longer adds uploaded .eseq effect files to the selected playlist as sequences (#7411)
- derwin12 — FPP Connect with "Keep window open" added sequences from earlier uploads to the playlist, not just the ones selected (#7395)
- derwin12 — FPP Connect: an effect sequence with no channels on a controller reports "Skipped - no channels on this controller" instead of "Already up to date"
